h3. What

With no filter or search and no work orders, the views show the design's first-run state instead of the filtered empty state.

h3. Expected

S1-N1c: "When no filter and no search are active and the filter view has no work orders at all, Tech View and Board View show the design's first-run state: the clipboard-list icon in a grey circle, 'No work orders yet', then 'Create a work order and assign a technician to see it here.', with a Create Work Order button that does the same as the page's Create Work Order button. List keeps its production empty state."

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v55|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S1-N1c, S1-R9a).

h3. Actual (origin/develop, 2026-10-15)

Both views show the filtered empty state (magnifier and "No work orders found.") whether or not a filter or search is active. "No work orders found." is not in the PRD or the design.

h3. How to check

* With no filter or search and an empty filter view, both views show the clipboard icon, both lines of text word for word, and a Create Work Order button that opens the same flow as the page button.
* With a filter or search active and no matches, the filtered states in S1-N1a and S1-N1b show instead.
* List is unchanged.

From the PRD v54/v55 rulings on Bilal's and Slavcho's questions, 2026-10-15.
